title: Trap seal maintenance.
officialText: A water supply pipe not less than 1/ inch (6.4 mm) in diameter shall be taken from the flush 4 supply of each bedpan washer on the discharge or fixture side of the vacuum breaker, shall be trapped to form not less than a 3-inch (76 mm) water seal, and shall be connected to the local vent stack on each floor. The water supply shall be installed so as to provide a supply of water to the local vent stack for cleansing and drain trap seal maintenance each time a bedpan washer is flushed.
